test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Mechanical
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Mechanical"** means something that is operated by machinery or done without thought or spontaneity; it is automatic and lacks emotion or originality. (यांत्रिक) • **Example: **His responses were so** mechanical** that it felt like he wasn't even listening. • **"Manual"** refers to something that is done with the hands or by a person rather than a machine. (हाथ से किया हुआ) • **Example: Manual** labor can be very exhausting but also rewarding. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'mechanical'** is **'manual'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Surrogate** (प्रतिनिधि): A substitute, especially a person deputizing for another in a specific role or office. • **Example:** She acted as a surrogate mother for the couple. • **Automatised** (स्वचालित): Something that is made to operate automatically or without human intervention. • **Example:** The factory has fully automatised its production line. • **Yielding** (झुकने वाला): Giving way under pressure; not stiff or rigid. • **Example:** The material is soft and yielding underfoot. 17e:T1366,
